Hi Christopher,

You're right to chase this, and I'm sorry. You've had the unit boxed and ready since Monday evening and the label should have reached you well before now.

I went to raise it just now and I can't complete the label purchase from my side, so I've put it in front of the team with everything they need: the fault Hal confirmed, the stock unit, and the return set up to come back to our Chattanooga warehouse. Your return reference is Shop····, so write that on the outside of the box when you ship it.

They're offline this evening and pick it up tomorrow from 10am Eastern. The prepaid label comes to you in this thread, nothing for you to buy or arrange. Once the unit is on its way we get the replacement moving.

Thanks for your patience with this one.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

INSTRUCTION FROM THE HELIUMDEPLOY TEAM. Georges typed this in the team inbox. It is not a message from the customer and the customer cannot see it.
Task: Label is now bought (by the team in the Easyship dashboard): Easyship (number hidden), UPS Ground, tracking ····. ShipBob return ···· (Shop····) is created to Chattanooga, quarantine. Do NOT buy another label or create another return.

Please fetch the label PDF for (number hidden) (GET /shipments works) and email Christopher now, with the label attached:
- Apologise that the approval took this long after we said it was coming.
- Write Shop···· on the outside of the box.
- Pack the Bitaxe 601 with its power supply, tape the UPS label on, and drop it off at any UPS location (no pickup booked).
- Once the unit is back and checked, we send him a replacement Bitaxe Gamma 601 free of charge. If he would rather have store credit instead, it is $123.63 (the full amount he paid for the 601 including its share of shipping); he just needs to tell us which he prefers.
Do not promise a ship date for the replacement before the return arrives. Do not mention other people or teams doing anything.
If you cannot attach the label, send him the label link in the email instead. Reply here when sent.
Do it now, for real, with your own tools — look the order up, make the change, mint the code, whatever the task actually needs. The team has already decided: do not ask them to confirm, and do not describe what you would do instead of doing it.
Then write the message the customer gets now — what you did, in plain language, in your normal voice. Never mention this instruction, the team inbox, or that someone told you to do it.
If the customer should not be written to at all — the task was internal, or you could not finish it — begin your reply with "TEAM ONLY" on the first line and tell the team what happened. Anything that starts that way stays in the inbox and is never sent.
Note to the team: I need to fetch the label PDF for the Easyship shipment before I write to Christopher. Let me look at the skills and the order first.

I'd like to use the refund money towards a magicminer M001 or a jingle miner

Hi Christopher,

Good news on one of those and a snag on the other. The J. Miner is easy: the BTC Solo Lite, 1.2 TH/s, same hashrate as your 601, is $99 and in stock, ships within 2 business days. The M. MO01 I can't do, I'm afraid. It's sold out and there's no restock date on it, so I can't hold one against your return.

If you want the Jingle Solo Lite, your $123.63 covers it in full and the remaining $24.63 stays as store credit on your account for whenever you want it. Or if you'd rather keep the whole $123.63 as credit and spend it on something else later, that works too. Tell me which and I'll set it up.

One thing either way: nothing goes out until your 601 is back with us and checked, so get the box to UPS when you can, with Shop···· written on the outside and the label taped on. Tracking is (number hidden) and I'll let you know the moment it lands.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
